title: Wooden Saw
body:
Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Reason: Removed early on in development


Description

Wooden Saw was a saw that new players were supposed to recieve at the start of the game. It was supposed to be worst saw in the game, being also sold at The Oak Depot.

Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price.

This saw was removed very early on in development due to being unneeded, as it barely had any significant stat differences compared to the Rusty Saw.

Appearance

Wooden Saw, like the name implies, is a typical looking saw made entirely out of wood.

It's handle is made out of yellowish brown wood. Blade is yellow in color with the same material applied to it.

Trivia

  • This tool is a part of the group of removed starter tools. Those being the Wooden Axe, Wooden Chisel and Wooden Pickaxe.
